name: Cliff Survival
author: Puhal
description:
Survive as long as possible while an increasing and incoming number of waves will try to knock you off. Grab powerups and stay alive! CONTROLS: WASD/Arrow Keys/LeftJoystick* - Movement, Mouse Wheel UpDown/RightJoystick* - Rotate Camera. *Available only for mobile devices.
UPDATE - Added a leaderboard. If you get a higher score, it will change your previous score, instead of creating a new entry.
